جنتا (form I)
# جَنَّتَا (jannatā) /d͡ʒan.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of جَنَّ (janna)
# جُنَّتَا (junnatā) /d͡ʒun.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
